response.overview: Eagles: The Majestic Hunters is a one-hour wildlife documentary narrated by Sir David Attenborough (also listed on IMDb with a 1991 TV release, directed by Peter Bassett and Pamela Halford, and written by Pamela Halford). It explores over 20 eagle species across five continents, highlighting their hunting methods, habitats, and conservation challenges.
response.title: Eagles The Majestic Hunters
